# Shoppingey.com

> Independent hands-on Amazon product reviews tested, scored on a transparent 5-point rubric, and organized across 5 core home, workshop, kitchen, decor, and garden departments (30 reviews total). Prices on Amazon fluctuate dynamically, so live price tiers are shown rather than fixed dollar quotes.

## Key Resources
- [Homepage & Full Review Directory](https://www.shoppingey.com/): Complete index of tested product reviews.
- [About Shoppingey.com](https://www.shoppingey.com/about): Editorial independence, mission, and team info.
- [How We Review Products](https://www.shoppingey.com/how-we-review): 5-point testing rubric (Build Quality, Performance, Value, Ease of Use, Durability).
- [Full AI Catalog Digest (Markdown)](https://www.shoppingey.com/llms-full.txt): Complete product summaries, pros, cons, technical specs, and FAQs.
- [Structured AI Product Feed (JSON)](https://www.shoppingey.com/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable catalog schema for AI shopping agents.
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.shoppingey.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable URLs.
